title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.34420v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-page document vision-language models encode each page independently, creating a feature-level discontinuity at page boundaries: visual tokens are formed without access to content on adjacent pages, and the language model must reason over these page representations formed in isolation. We introduce DocSEAM (Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking), a lightweight module inserted between a pretrained vision encoder and the language model that injects the inductive bias of local cross-page context into visual representations. For each page, DocSEAM forms a local triplet with its two neighbors, applies center-anchored masked self-attention with directional salience gates to fuse information from neighbor pages, and returns only the enriched center-page tokens, leaving the visual token count unchanged. translated_title: DocSEAM：面向多页文档理解的双向跨页编码
translated_abstract: 多页文档视觉-语言模型通常独立编码每一页，导致页边界处出现特征层面的不连续性：视觉标记的生成无法访问相邻页面的内容，而语言模型只能基于这些孤立生成的页面表示进行推理。我们提出DocSEAM（通过锚定掩码实现文档选择性增强），这是一个插入在预训练视觉编码器与语言模型之间的轻量级模块，它将局部跨页上下文的归纳偏置注入视觉表示。对于每一页，DocSEAM与其前后两页构成一个局部三元组，应用以中心页为锚的掩码自注意力机制及方向性显著性门控来融合相邻页面的信息，并仅返回增强后的中心页标记，同时保持视觉标记数量不变。经过监督式跨页预热训练以及在DocSEAM冻结状态下的多页微调后，我们的90亿参数模型达到了最先进的性能水平。
tldr: DocSEAM是一种插入在视觉编码器与语言模型之间的轻量级双向跨页编码模块，通过以中心页为锚的掩码自注意力融合相邻页面信息，在不改变视觉标记数量的前提下解决了多页文档理解中页面独立编码导致的特征不连续问题。
en_tdlr: DocSEAM is a lightweight bidirectional cross-page encoding module inserted between the vision encoder and language model that fuses neighboring page information via center-anchored masked self-attention with directional salience gates, resolving feature discontinuity at page boundaries in multi-page document understanding without increasing visual token count.
